in_marathi.name: Nabhitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cosmos
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabhitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nabhita is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nabhah' which means 'the sky' or 'the cosmos'. This name is a feminine variation of the masculine name 'Nabhah'. Nabhita is the goddess of the sky and the cosmos in Hindu mythology. She is also known as the goddess of agriculture and the harvest. She is the wife of Lord Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
